labels.caption: Boundary conditions of part second on weeks 101 (1 week, policy seed 0), one row per policy: the median cost over all-fallback with its range over the weeks (the weeks being rotations of one series) under (a) L-vr, the trace lender with buffer violations turned into reclaims without notice: no buffer violation occurred in its 12 runs, so its cost equals the trace lender's for every policy on every week; (b) L-rf, the trace lender refusing purchases on unavailable layers; (c) L-ad, the adaptive lender, which announces every lease at the end of its guaranteed period (on these weeks its cost equals that of the eager lender L-eg and of the i.i.d. lender at $p=1$ for every policy: each announces every revocable lease when its guaranteed period ends); (d) the trace lender with the P99.9 lease buffer; (e) the trace lender with demand lagged by one slot, for the policy of its row on slot $t-1$'s demand (RetroRenting-style: its lagged build), each marker in the lagged variant's style. Grey ticks: the row's policy under the trace lender on the same weeks (part main); grey line: all-fallback. Per-week values in Tables~\ref{tab:e7v2-boundary} and \ref{tab:e7v2-lag}; the E5 menus and the gap days in Tables~\ref{tab:e7v2-e5} and \ref{tab:e7v2-gap}.
